'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male NPC Septimontian who can be found with '''Alma''' or alone by the cable cars in Septimont, [[Capitoline Hill City]]. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Idle from Unnamed NPC near by, Afternoon)
:;Why is that [[Buling|foreign girl]] in strange clothing riding the cable car over and over again? Hasn't she seen enough of the city?

;(Idle, Afternoon)
:;'''Laurence''' (Here goes nothing. I need to confess to Alma on the cable car. Today! But... will I have the guts to say it?)

;(Talk to Laurence, Afternoon)
:'''Alma''': The cable car again? Why do we ride the cable car at the end, every time we go out together?
:'''Alma''': Last time, you said you didn't get enough of the scenery on the left side. And then one other time, you said you couldn't line up a shot of me with the Colosseum in the background. What is it this time?
:'''Laurence''': I, uhm... I felt like doing some sea watching from someplace place {sic} today... I-Is that okay with you?
:'''Alma''': Yeah, I suppose.
----
;(Idle from Unnamed NPC near by, Night)
:;She's not the only one. That young couple spends their nights on cable cars.
:;Is there something particularly alluring about cable cars that I've missed, even after decades living in Septimont?

;(Idle, Night)
:;'''Alma''' He comes here even at night? Oh, Laurence, just how much are you in love with cable cars?
:;'''Alma''' I see. From now, I won't say another word again if he wants to go on cable car rides. Everyone's allowed freedom to their own interests.

:;'''Laurence''' And we said goodbye right after a cable ride again. She probably thinks I'm a cable car freak by now. I wanted to confess to her!

:(Talk to Laurence, Night)
:'''Laurence''': And we said goodbye right after a cable ride again. She probably thinks I'm a cable car freak by now. I wanted to confess to her!
:'''Laurence''': Umm... Alma... I.... Uhh. I like...
----
;(After completing 2.6 Main Act; [[By Sun's Burning Hand]])<!--may need verification-->
;(Day)
:'''Alma''': All this time, you wanted to say you love me while on the cable car? You could've done this earlier.
:'''Laurence''': I was afraid you'd turn me down, and the cable car felt like a good spot to do it.
:'''Laurence''': After all these rides, I found out that the perfect moment to do it is when we crest the mountain top with the sea slowly coming into view. Romantic, isn't it?
:'''Alma''': Yes, yes. I don't deny that. But just so you know, I wouldn't said yes no matter where you did it, dummy.
:'''Laurence''': Oh, Alma...
----
;(After completing 2.6 Main Act; [[By Sun's Burning Hand]])<!--may need verification-->
;(Night)
:'''Alma''': By the way, I noticed you walking in circles here ever day.
:'''Alma''': And I was wondering, how on Solaris could someone be so obsessed with cable cars? But turns out you were practicing for your confession, weren't you?
:'''Laurence''': Oh, you saw that... I ... Err....
:'''Alma''': Don't be shy about it. I'm really happy how deeply you value our relationship.
:'''Laurence''': Whimpers. Alma!
{{Dialogue End}}
